items.headline: TSMC posts a sixth straight record-profit quarter and guides Q4 sales up to $54.3B, but the stock still falls about 1.8%
items.why: Net income rose nearly 69% and 2026-2028 capital spending is guided even higher, so AI chip demand is intact while the share price shows the market is trading the sector's mood, not the results.

sources.title: TSMC stock drops despite record profit amid 'extremely robust demand' for AI chips

items.headline: Nvidia's CEO says frontier AI labs are only about a quarter to a third of its chip demand, as AI-revenue doubts hit tech stocks
items.why: The October sell-off was triggered by OpenAI's lower-than-leaked revenue figure; if Nvidia's demand is broader than a few labs, a slowdown at one lab matters less than the market priced (this is the company's own claim, not independently verified).

sources.title: Will AI Companies Generate Enough Revenue to Continue the Build-Out?

items.headline: US spot bitcoin ETFs take in $526.6M on Monday, the largest daily inflow in about a month, all of it from BlackRock's fund
items.why: BlackRock's IBIT added $665.2M while other funds were net negative and October month-to-date flows remain about $90.5M negative, so the demand is narrow rather than a broad return of buyers.

sources.title: Bitcoin ETFs just saw their biggest day in a month thanks entirely to BlackRock

items.headline: Bitcoin holds near $82,700 with $80,000 flagged as the level at risk if equities weaken
items.why: Ether ETFs saw a fourth straight day of outflows, so the bid is bitcoin-specific, and a break below $80,000 would be the first sign the equity sell-off is spilling into crypto.

sources.title: Equity weakness could damp demand for bitcoin after biggest ETF inflows in a month

items.headline: September US CPI comes in at 3.7% year over year, above forecasts; the 10-year Treasury yield jumps 9bp to 5.304%
items.why: A hotter-than-expected print keeps the Fed in tightening mode and long yields near 24-year highs, which raises the discount rate on every risk asset.

sources.title: September inflation sends Treasury yields surging

items.headline: Futures price about an 83% chance the Fed holds at its Oct 27-28 meeting and roughly a 92-94% chance of a hike in December
items.why: The Fed already raised its target range to 3.75%-4.00% on Sept 16, its first increase since 2023, and producer prices running at 6.3% a year keep the next move a hike, not a cut.

items.headline: Iran-mediation reports pull oil off a five-month high, but no de-escalation is confirmed and Hormuz shipments remain below prewar levels
items.why: Attacks on Gulf vessels and Saudi energy sites are the main driver of the oil price, which feeds inflation and the Fed path, so a real diplomatic deal would matter far more than the headlines.

sources.title: Oil Prices Whipsaw as Brent Hits $111.99 Then Falls on Iran Talks

items.headline: Brent touches $111.99, a five-month high, then settles at $108.79; December WTI settles at $97.82
items.why: A 13-dollar intraday-to-settle swing driven by headlines shows the supply risk premium is large and fragile, and it is the main input to the inflation numbers above.

sources.title: Oil Prices Whipsaw as Brent Hits $111.99 Then Falls on Iran Talks

items.headline: Gold slips to about $4,122 even as yields fall, while silver gains about 1.5% to near $57.80
items.why: Gold failing to rally on lower yields and a weak housing report shows expected Fed tightening outweighs its safe-haven bid, and silver outperforming points to industrial and oil-linked demand.

items.headline: S&P 500 closes at 7,712.57 (+0.28%) and the Dow at 52,495.88 (+1.02%) on Tuesday after Monday's tech-led rebound
items.why: Monday's Nasdaq gain of about 1.1% reversed part of Friday's AI sell-off, but Tuesday's Dow-led gain with the S&P lagging means the rebound has not yet shown broad tech leadership.

items.headline: Gold trades in a tight band: support near $4,132-$4,136 and resistance near $4,142-$4,171 at Monday's close, then a break lower Tuesday
items.why: Gold ended Monday near $4,138 inside that band and traded near $4,122 on Tuesday, below the $4,132 support, so the break is the signal and the former support now acts as resistance.
